name: What materials are best suited for a custom pergola in the Las Vegas climate?

mainEntity.name: What materials are best suited for a custom pergola in the Las Vegas climate?

acceptedAnswer.text: For the Las Vegas climate, materials that can withstand intense sun, heat, and occasional high winds are ideal. Popular choices include aluminum, which is durable, low-maintenance, and resistant to rust and pests. Treated lumber like cedar or redwood offers natural beauty but requires more maintenance to prevent weathering. Vinyl is another low-maintenance option that resists fading and warping. We help you select materials that balance aesthetics, durability, and your maintenance preferences.
acceptedAnswer.description: In Las Vegas, durable materials like aluminum, treated lumber (cedar, redwood), or vinyl are best. Aluminum is low-maintenance, while wood offers natural beauty but requires upkeep.
